modules.module_title: Plan to produce artisanal baked products

pcs.pc_description: obtain work requirements from various sources such as individuals, organizations, and market trends
identify the type of bakery products to be manufactured, including artisanal methods, manual processes, and small-batch production requirements, along with tools and equipment needed
document a standardized production plan for producing artisanal bakery products, ensuring recipe standardization, validation processes, and consistency
plan the production process by referring to process flow charts, formulation charts, and best practices for artisanal methods
check the availability of raw materials, packaging materials, equipment, and manpower required for production, ensuring seasonal, fresh, and locally sourced ingredients
plan the batch size based on the production order, machine capacity, and manual processing constraints
calculate material requirements for the baking process and prepare the indent, accordingly, considering small-batch efficiency
submit requirements, including indent, to the concerned personnel and address their queries promptly
inspect the work area for the presence of waste and hazardous materials
clean the work area using industry-approved sanitizers and chemical agents thoroughly
establish inspection and verification methods to evaluate the effectiveness of cleaning and sanitation programs
dispose of waste materials from the work area safely as per standard operating procedures (SOP)
inspect the production tools, equipment, and machinery for proper functioning
clean the production tools, equipment, and machinery thoroughly and calibrate them appropriately
assemble the materials and tools to be used as per standard work practices

modules.module_title: Select and test materials for production

pcs.pc_description: test samples thoroughly using sensory and manual evaluations such as touch, smell, and taste, alongside necessary chemical and biological testing
report substandard quality ingredients, ensuring documentation of quality issues for future reference
store the ingredients as per the standards set for artisanal production
record information such as materials received, batch size, and quality of products to ensure consistency in production
establish a small lab setup for conducting necessary sensory and quality evaluations to maintain artisanal product standards

pcs.pc_description: plan the baking process by selecting appropriate recipes and required ingredients
weigh and measure dry and wet ingredients as per recipe specifications
sift and combine dry ingredients such as flour, baking powder, baking soda, cocoa, starch powder etc.
add yeast to the mix depending on the product to be produced
check the quantity of the mixture and transfer it into the mixer appropriately
gradually mix dry ingredients into wet ingredients to prevent gluten formation
monitor mixing parameters such as speed, time, and temperature
store prepared mixes safely in designated areas
prepare and knead the mixture (dough or batter) to achieve the required consistency based on the product type, including bread, pastries, cookies, and cakes

select appropriate shapes, molds, trays, or shaping tools and pour or mold the mixture into suitable forms according to product specifications for various baked goods, including cakes, cookies, bread, and pastries
apply necessary fillings, layers, toppings, or decorations based on the product requirements
allow shaped products to rest, ferment, proof, or set as needed before baking or final processing
preheat ovens and set baking parameters based on product requirements
load baking trays or molds into the oven safely
monitor baking times and temperatures to achieve optimal texture and flavor
rotate trays if required to ensure even baking
remove baked goods and transfer them to a cooling station
inspect the product parameters to ensure desired quality Parameters: texture, flavor, color, odour, height, crumbliness etc.
use sight, feel and skewers to assess the quality of the baked products such as time, temperature, rotating speed, conveyor speed, etc. Products: cake, pie, tart, etc.
handover the samples to the quality lab for testing and final approval Testing: physical, chemical, microbiological, organoleptic, etc.
add ingredients such as emulsifiers, preservatives, colours and flavours etc. into the premix as per requirements
prepare and ferment dough using appropriate techniques for various baked goods, such as sourdough, brioche, whole wheat bread, multigrain bread, baguettes, burger buns, dinner rolls, and croissants
monitor proofing and fermentation times to ensure proper texture and flavor development
apply appropriate pressure to punch down the risen dough and place it in the loaf pan for the next fermentation cycle and proofing
inspect the quality of the dough thoroughly and check for undesirable characteristics such as cracking, over fermented, under fermented, water absorption capacity, etc.
divide the dough into balls of standard sizes, select appropriate molds, and place the dough balls to ensure they acquire the desired shape
apply scoring, glazing, or toppings as per recipe requirements for different products, including seeded bread, milk buns, and laminated pastries like croissants and Danish pastries
bake breads (e.g., white bread, rye bread, ciabatta), buns (e.g., hot dog buns, brioche buns), and croissants at controlled temperatures for the required duration.
cool and store finished products under suitable conditions to maintain freshness and quality.

modules.module_title: Producing artisanal cakes—different flavors and varieties

pcs.pc_description: prepare cake batters of different varieties, including sponge, chiffon, pound, cupcakes, etc. as per the recipe
add flavors, colors, and fillings to achieve desired taste profiles for cakes, cupcakes, and other baked confections
select the toppings and add them on the dough/batter like choco chips, cherries, sprinklers, etc.
pour the batter or place the dough into molds of various shapes and trim or shape it as required to meet the product specifications
bake the cakes at the correct temperatures and for the appropriate duration as per the recipe
cool cakes, cupcakes, and other baked goods properly before applying frosting or decoration
prepare cream fat according to the recipe formulation, incorporating desired flavors for icing, and apply center or sandwich fillings as needed
decorate using standard techniques such as layering, piping, glazing, and applying various toppings as per product requirements

modules.module_title: Producing cookies, rusk, and puff pastries

pcs.pc_description: prepare dough for cookies, puff pastries, and rusk, shaping them as per product specifications
add ingredients such as nuts, chocolate chips, dried fruits, or other mix-ins as required.
bake cookies, puff pastries, and rusks at optimal temperatures to achieve the desired texture, such as crispiness or flakiness.
prepare and bake rusk using double-baking techniques, and monitor the texture and flavor of additional baked items like croissants and puff pastries
select and load appropriate packaging materials onto machines or arrange them for manual packaging based on the product type
transfer baked products safely for packaging, ensuring they are placed properly to prevent damage
monitor the wrapping and labeling process to ensure compliance with specifications and FSSAI packaging and labeling standards
record product details such as name, batch number, time of packing, manufacturing and expiry dates, label details, and packaging materials (primary and secondary) using manual or ERP systems
pack cakes, pastries, pies, tarts, and other baked goods hygienically to maintain freshness and quality
store packaged and reusable by-products under optimal environmental conditions to preserve their quality and shelf life
arrange and display cakes, pastries, pies, and tarts aesthetically using appropriate trays, cases, or racks to attract maximum attention.
use suitable service wares to present and store baked products while maintaining hygiene and freshness.
adjust and monitor storage conditions for displayed baked goods to ensure optimal quality and replenish stock as needed.

modules.module_title: Managing finished goods and post-production activities

pcs.pc_description: inspect the quality of finished products before dispatch to ensure they meet required standards.
record and maintain details of production, including inventory, waste, spoilage, vendor information, customer details, material receipts, and shipment timelines.
coordinate with vendors for the distribution and supply of baked products to individuals and organizations.
monitor and manage stocked materials (raw, processed, and finished goods) to ensure quality and quantity align with purchase orders.
repair minor faults in baking equipment and arrange maintenance when necessary to ensure smooth operations.
maintain a clean and hygienic workspace, implementing pest control measures and ensuring proper waste disposal as per standard operating procedures.
clean and sanitize work areas, machinery, equipment, and tools using appropriate cleaning agents and disinfectants
